payload.summary: A ward DOM-test sweep recorded 61 findings and wrote out only 8; the other 53 exist nowhere
payload.detail: docs/ward-flow/wf-build3-004-dom-test-sweep.md details 8 findings and summarises the remaining 53 thematically. The count survived, the content did not. Surfaced when another chat asked whether a specific blind test was among the six recorded for one file and the question could not be answered - four of those six exist in no document and in no surviving agent report. A count that cannot be checked, triaged or compared is the only use that document had. Recommended disposition from Ward Builder One: retire and re-run, not recover.
